topic: Analytics dashboard updates and data review
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on reviewing and updating an analytics dashboard for a specific facility. Initial discussions covered two models available on the staging environment, with one participant estimating a quick turnaround time (potentially 30 minutes) to review or adjust them.

Key decisions involved deploying a fix and reviewing data sources. A dataset was shared that had been pre-aggregated by someone else, starting from January 1, 2022. The dashboard's display issues were noted, including an extra, possibly invisible column and the removal of a funnel visualization.

Regarding metrics, it was clarified that the '% vs Total' metric represents percentages based on total sessions, not unique users (uniks).

The final shared dataset link provided updated data for the facility using a broader date range.
decisions: A fix was deployed to the production environment.
The dashboard utilized pre-aggregated data starting from 2022-01-01.
It was confirmed that '% vs Total' represents percentages based on total sessions.
action_items: Someone needs to investigate and fix the layout issues (extra columns, missing funnel) on the dashboard.
A screenshot of the analytics data for 'Krone' covering January 1st to three months is required.
